text:
maya: heads-up — i followed the python quickstart async example and it's throwing AttributeError. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/python/quickstart

zane: ugh, thanks for flagging. which snippet exactly?

maya: the async chat example near the bottom under "async usage". copy-pasted as-is:
```py
from redwood import Client

client = Client(api_key=MY_KEY)

async def main():
    resp = await client.chat.completions.create(
        model='open-redwood/r1',
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}]
    )
    print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

maya: stacktrace: ``AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'chat'``

kai: sounds like the SDK surface changed — we now expose `client.chat.create(...)` directly (no `completions` namespace) in v0.9. the docs snippet is stale.

olivia: also noticed the quickstart links to the sample-app repo but that GH link is 404: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-quickstart-sample-app

sam: filed a quick issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/987 — but we should probably patch the snippet + fix the link.

zane: could we change the snippet to the minimal supported usage? suggestion:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=MY_KEY)

async def main():
    resp = await client.chat.create(
        model='open-redwood/r1',
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}]
    )
    print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

zane: also add a short note about typing: the example uses `Client` in some places and `RedwoodClient` in others which confuses IDEs. we should include `from redwood import RedwoodClient  # type: ignore` or add proper TypedClient export.

docs-bot: opened PR to update quickstart snippet and repair sample-app link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342 (draft) :eyes:

maya: awesome, thanks. can we also add a tiny smoke test in CI to catch snippet drift? even a single integration check that runs the quickstart sample would help.

kai: agree — i'll add a lightweight smoke job in docs CI that runs `python -m examples.quickstart_async` against a mocked/stubbed client.

olivia: cc @devex — onboarding emails have pointed people to that broken sample for the past week, we should queue a small announcement to staging customers. :/

sam: note to self: follow up on the GH 404 — repo moved to `examples/python/quickstart` under `redwood-inference` org. update link to https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/tree/main/python/quickstart

maya: thank you all. i'll verify the PR once CI is green and then mark the thread resolved. :thumbsup:
